# Cyber Swap

> Cyber Swap is a non-custodial web interface for swapping tokens on Cyber, an Ethereum layer-2 from CyberConnect that is part of the Optimism Superchain. It quotes routes through on-chain liquidity and lets users sign swaps from their own wallet. Gas on Cyber is paid in ETH.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- Cyber Swap swaps tokens on Cyber, an Ethereum layer-2 built by CyberConnect.
- Cyber is part of the Optimism Superchain, and gas on it is paid in ETH.
- The interface is non-custodial: users connect a wallet and sign every transaction.
- Tokens must already be on Cyber to be swapped there; bridging from Ethereum is a separate step with its own fee.
- ERC-20 sell tokens need a one-time approval; native ETH does not.

## Pages

- Legal: https://cyber-swap.github.io/legal.html
